extraction_scope.anti_overclaim_policy: Computational/model-membrane evidence is not promoted to direct mechanism without the bacterial leakage/time-kill assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: PLS-S1, PLS-S2, and PLS-S4 directly permeabilize bacterial cytoplasmic membranes; ONPG/beta-galactosidase leakage and time-kill assays support membrane disruption occurring with cell killing.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Curves are not digitized into exact time-series values; the claim is restricted to source-stated membrane permeabilization/disruption and killing kinetics.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD and DSC model-membrane experiments support amphipathic alpha-helix formation and perturbation of anionic lipid acyl-chain packing, consistent with membrane-disruptive activity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: phylloseptins-S tested in membrane mimetics, especially PLS-S1, PLS-S2, and PLS-S4
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model membrane biophysics supports the mechanism but is not treated as a standalone cellular mechanism without the bacterial leakage and time-kill assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular dynamics docking predicts insertion of alpha-helical PLS-S2 into an E. coli membrane model; this remains computational context, not direct experimental proof.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational docking is preserved as supporting context only and is not promoted to direct mechanism evidence.
